overclaims: "Agents" is read as AI agents in general, including the coding agents behind most enterprise tokenmaxxing.
For coding agents, the kind behind most enterprise tokenmaxxing, measured use is about 1,000 times code chat.
So the part about coding agents on one benchmark holds.
The claim does not hold for agentic workflows in general, based on the one period estimate that covers them.
checks.note: The packet does not establish coding agents' share of enterprise tokenmaxxing. The categorical conclusions exceed the evidence: the 1,000x finding is unconfirmed for the target-period version, and one secondary estimate cannot settle workflows generally. Dating the quoted e1 finding as available April 24 is unverified; the October revision caveat does not repair that citation.
